An independent exact-16c check confirms the source late-HEAD failure and identifies the same mutation-time gap at the canonical publisher boundary. A real completed owner application plus the maintained owner→publisher interface fixture still publishes after an empty or unrelated tracked commit before `publish`, and after an empty commit immediately after publisher `prepare`. Canonical projection, policy reconstruction, native receipt maker/replay and guarded writes execute; external generation is the maintained test fixture's explicit stub, so this is not described as a full Claw replay.

The source baseline and captured generation MIM revision still agree with each other. Current MIM HEAD is not checked by publisher preparation/rechecks; existing actual revision checks concern Claw and KG. Add a mutation-only actual MIM HEAD == accepted source baseline check before publication and in its existing capture/write/receipt rechecks. Keep the existing revision and content guards.

Historical source `verify_completed` and publisher `validate` must continue to verify a valid past operation after later commits when its exact required content remains unchanged. Independent positive controls confirm that behavior; current-owner tampering still refuses. Do not place an unconditional current-HEAD restriction in the shared historical verifier.

Evidence: `preflight/late-head-transaction-independent-v1/{ASSESSMENT.md,probe-v2.py,results.json,run-v2.log}` in the campaign's private durable packet. Original W08 findings and the refused first replay caused by K's authorized #1255 advancement remain preserved. No maintained data or code was changed by this review.

Independent adversarial re-review of exact PR1205 head `21061aa532401398db70c59a596debf330f70744` confirms two residual gaps in this issue's correction. They are recorded before further fixes; this head is not approved for application.

1. **W08-21061-SRC-001 (major): staged index-only changes escape source scope checks.** Modifying and staging tracked `MAPPING_SEMANTICS.md`, then restoring its original working bytes, makes the working-tree diff against the accepted baseline empty while the cached diff contains the unrelated file. Actual unchanged prepare/apply/completed verification return a complete receipt in both initial and post-prepare variants. Clean positives and ordinary working-byte drift negatives behave correctly. The live guard must independently inspect the cached/index delta with the same literal NUL path handling, define allowed owner-path staging precisely, and retain both scope checks at prewrite, transition and final boundaries. Historical completed verification must retain its separate contract.

2. **W08-21061-PUB-001 (major): the last source-proof replay outlives the publisher HEAD check.** In an actual pinned-Claw source→generation→publication fixture, the independent wrapper runs the real source proof and then makes a real private commit inside the final live recheck. Because the HEAD callback already ran, publication returns complete and both success receipts remain populated despite a changed HEAD. No proof or native generation result is fabricated. Retain the live HEAD check through the end of the complete recheck, after source-proof replay and remaining validations. Preserve ordinary uncommitted derived synchronization and valid historical verification after later commits.

Required regression coverage includes pre-prepare and post-prepare hidden-index changes, midflight/final source boundaries, the actual late-final-proof publisher injection with honest failure/recovery receipts, Unicode/newline paths, clean positives, real native generation and historical verification. Keep all prior assertions and both original findings; passing focused tests did not establish complete adversarial coverage.

Exact evidence is captured in `.temp/all-unmatched-20261107/preflight/late-head1256-residual-findings-publication-v1/inputs.json`, preserving originals under `workers/w08/worktree/.temp/final-21061-independent-v1/`. Source result SHA256 `1eaf8dabd6d44c4586aca0f35a7f5c1bde43a5999f7984b794b4a67b57ca16cf`; publisher native-boundary result `6f26de0d1aedac258eed89d4498be53d04e4f119f7425f0c73592429095e6ab6`. Actual source module `21ced557b3ff36bb3db2ac8d092b0af3d46bff1db6045221bdeabb128d4b9022`; publisher `5abfc833c8b52ab1d83a13cf1cdfb67b8c325afc354d015b1e09e42e6ed0a60c`. Separate technical and skeptical readbacks confirm the saved Git objects, native output and receipt state. No maintained campaign ingredient application occurred, and no source/scientific/export approval is inferred.

Independent exact-head review at `7d4db26a2ce75e9942badaca954bb8e8f821c75c` confirms the original hidden-index and final publisher-proof examples are now refused, but identifies a narrower remaining source defect: **W08-7D4DB26-SRC-001, major — index coherence across the final live check**. This remains part of #1256; no duplicate issue is needed.

The source checks cached paths, then stage entries/blobs, then HEAD. A real index update after the cached listing can add an unrelated contract path outside the captured list. A real replacement after an allowed owner's blob read can leave unaccepted staged bytes while the stale read still passes. Both actual private native applications return complete receipts with accepted working bytes and unchanged HEAD. The same update before the cached listing correctly fails, and clean staging of installed accepted endpoints correctly succeeds, including later historical verification.

The independent probe uses sys.setprofile only to schedule real git hash-object/update-index calls at actual native call/return boundaries. It does not replace native functions, returned values or generation. Root worker08 reproduced both cases; separate technical/skeptical confirmation and its complete review are still running. This comment precedes correction. No maintained campaign application has occurred; final full validation has not started on this known-defective head.

Bounded correction: bind a coherent stage/path/mode/blob index view through each complete live check, while allowing harmless Git stat-cache refresh and legitimate installed-endpoint staging between checks. Keep literal paths, initial/midflight scope checks, honest failure/recovery receipts and historical verification unchanged. Do not claim global atomic protection against arbitrary writes after the final observation boundary.

Required regression cases: late unrelated entry after enumeration; late allowed-owner blob replacement after its real read; positive staged installed endpoints; legitimate subsequent historical commit; harmless stat-cache refresh. Preserve every existing test/assertion and all prior negative controls. No threshold, gate, workflow or pin change.

Evidence: `.temp/all-unmatched-20261107/workers/w08/worktree/.temp/final-7d4db26-independent-v1/`; finding SHA256 `baeb59614d7c5622046168c1046da90871908dcca5de70156570a8582d816fbd`; actual four-case results `8acd02e076ad3f9c29239f28d09e1b289bcb5a475b2e90abdd6d30dfcca76a69`; original probe `9cc31f43022971529a6a096cd9151e5e0b2380d4f4c8b4784491b63b8b0a9166`. Exact source SHA256 `72e084da60235b8b285a27c603d4715edf087c82957f555e1e631cf9e338bbd6`. Original and successor reviews remain separately scoped and retained.

The private bracket fix closes the two original one-way mutations, but an independent actual-native probe found a narrower within-observation mismatch at source `adba0b6b…`.

Both full index snapshots contain the same invalid blob. Between those observations, real Git writes temporarily restore the accepted index while the separate cached-path/entry/blob checks run, then restore the invalid blob before the final snapshot. Both the unrelated-contract and planned-owner variants return `complete`; no mutation occurs after the final read. A clean control succeeds, and leaving the invalid blob visible throughout correctly refuses.

The bounded fix should validate the captured stage/path/mode/blob snapshot itself, or prove every validated subview equals that captured view, then recheck the final logical snapshot. Preserve stat-cache refresh, legitimate installed staging, literal paths, and historical completed verification after later commits. This does not request global atomic protection or a current-index requirement on historical replay.

Native functions/results were not replaced; the probe only schedules real private Git index writes. Source payloads, maintained checkouts and scientific approval are untouched. Exact original/final snapshots, receipts, probe and source hashes are retained in the independent packet. Finding `IR-INDEX-COHERENCE-001` is a continuation of `W08-7D4DB26-SRC-001` under #1256, not a new unrelated issue.

Filed before the successor correction. The private bracket-only attempt was not committed or applied to campaign owners. Its84 partial source-test passes and deliberate interruption are preserved separately; they are not a full-suite result.
